ploidyspec report: fCorLav1

Summary

Structure in this individual's assembly, read from the sections below; not inheritance and not origin. See docs/guide, Chapter 6.

Ploidy

2 haplotype copies of each of 40 chromosome numbers; no older duplicated sets detected.

Confidence: high. Evidence: copies from the assembly (2 per number)

Auto-like or allo-like?

Allo-like (disomic-like): the duplicated sets do not interchange, from homeolog pairs (pair-depth CV 0.15). This is also what a long-rediploidized autopolyploid looks like.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: 10 chromosome numbers assessed: 10 split into lineages, 0 tetrasomic-like, 0 one divergent copy, 0 candidate

TE markers

Only the absolute marker fraction is available (two copies per number); it does not separate diploid, auto- and allopolyploid, so no reading is made from it.

Confidence: not assessable. Evidence: te_marker_fraction mean 0.1072

Rediploidization

Advanced: no stretch where homeologs are as close as alleles, and the karyotype has been rearranged since the duplication. Also: 2 chromosome(s) carry blocks homeologous to two or more others (chr03:chr07+chr13, chr13:chr03+chr05): fusions, fissions or translocations since the duplication; homeolog blocks diverged to different depths (CV 0.35), as when regions resolve at different times; homeologous-exchange candidates on 2 chromosome(s), stretches closer to the homeolog than to the own homolog (exchange, or a contig placed on the wrong chromosome).

Confidence: medium. Evidence: residual tetrasomy on 0/16 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers; pair-depth CV 0.15; homeology map: 17% of the genome in 32 homeolog blocks, 9 chromosome pairs, block-divergence CV 0.35; exchange: chr28(chr02:1/2);chr35(chr38:1/2)

Copy number and copy divergence (whole-chromosome matrix)

Hierarchically reordered, chromosome-number resolution

Same distance data as the heatmaps above, but collapsed to one value per chromosome NUMBER (haplotype copies aggregated away) and reordered by average-linkage clustering -- shows cross-chromosome (subgenome/ancestral-pair) structure cleanly, including diffuse structure with no individually FDR-significant pair. Red outlines mark individually FDR-accepted pairs from the homeolog test below. See INTERPRETATION.md's "checkerboard" section.
